description: This file contains multiple C# classes that define Orleans grains with generic type parameters, state serialization, storage providers, and various grain behaviors including messaging, state management, cancellation, and interface implementation. It appears to serve both as a source code defining grain logic and as a test suite for Orleans generic grain features.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrainState
classes.description: Serializable state class holding two properties of generic type T.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrain1
classes.description: Grain storing and retrieving values A and B of type T with basic set/get methods and formatted string outputs.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrainUsingAzureStorageAndLongGrainName
classes.description: Azure storage-enabled grain implementing echo and clear state functionalities.

classes.name: TinyNameGrain
classes.description: Alias similar to SimpleGenericGrainUsingAzureStorageAndLongGrainName, with echo and clear state methods.

classes.name: SimpleGenericGrain2
